title: John was great!!
text: John was EXCELLENT and very accommodating. He is very knowledgeable about the city and made it a tremendous experience for us. Highly recommend John and this tour.
author: Mary_S

title: Barcelona in 2 Hours
text: Carla, our driver was fantastic! We booked the 2 hour tour which gave us a very good overview of Barcelona. The morning was a bit cool to start out but blankets were provided which made the world of a different. Highly recommend this tour.
author: Tracy_K

title: We are very happy
text: The best tuk tuk experience to discover Barcelona. Very friendly guides
author: Companion41925919453

title: Excelent
text: It was excellent experience specially with Carla gwapa. She gave us a 2 hours tour, informative including history, recommended restaurant 7 portes was perfect. We walked from where she dropped us in the city, giving us direction thru the old part of town passing by piccaso museum (closed already for the day). We will recommend your company to our family and friends encouraging them to visit Barcelona. And, definitely we will come back to Barcelona maybe with our grandchildren. Thanks Carla from the family
author: 652ramont

title: Perfect Day 1
text: Carla was a great guide! She made sure we were comfortable with blankets for the chilly day. She shared history of the city and the culture. Carla took us around the city so we could get a lay of the land. Even stopped for us to get a picture along the way. We learned a lot and would highly recommend!
author: Colleen_C

title: Fun experience
text: Nice little ride around the city. We had two tuk-tuks and enjoyed the tour of the city. Both of our guides were knowledgeable and incredibly friendly.
author: Kristin_L

title: The best city sights on tuk tuk
text: We had the best day with John our tour guide. He was knowledgeable, fun, and a great personality. We did a 3hr tour and got to see most of the city sights I highly recommend John . Loved the tuk tuk golf cart , best way to get around the city
author: Jeanne_B

title: Great trip
text: Very interesting and informative, Leonardo was brilliant, not only showed us all the places of interest but gave us some tips - thank you for telling us about the museum at Sagrada Família and for our metro map - got us back to hotel. Would definitely recommend this trip 🤗
author: Mark_S

title: Fantastic Tuk Tuk ride
text: What a great way to get an initial view of what to see in Barcelona! Our driver was very knowledgeable, taking us to landmarks and explaining the history about them. We were given time to do a little exploring by ourselves at some locations. By the end of our tour we had a sound idea of how Barcelona was set out and what landmarks we wanted to revisit and explore more. Thoroughly enjoyed this tour. A fun way to get around.
author: Fiona_B

title: As my mom said, I can’t...
text: As my mom said, I can’t believe John knows so much information. It was truly amazing!  For me, it was perfect a short tour of the main attractions that I want to see. John made us very comfortable and was very approachable - additionally offered us blankets which was needed on that day. Would highly recommend.
author: Tracy_S
